audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and level 6 are marked Skill and 2+ items is marked Fiora, contradicting the mirror's chart and the page's own whys ('this is her duel peak', 'the level-6 window swings to her', 'you reclaim it through utility').
audit.why: Riposte plus Lunge give her the duel from 2 through her first item; Karma's reclaim is teamfight utility at two items, not the 1v1.
audit.corrected: Skill / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Karma — one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is template text that never names Grand Challenge.
audit.why: Mantra is up from level 1, so 6 is flat for Karma; Grand Challenge (110/90/70s) reveals all four Vitals and heals her and nearby allies on completion.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named as Fiora's, with the healing stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names none of Fiora's abilities except Riposte, and describes Riposte as 'parries your damage and CC, then stuns' — which reads as though it always stuns.
audit.why: Riot's text: the stab slows the first champion hit, OR stuns them if Riposte blocked an immobilizing effect. Leading with Focused Resolve is what upgrades her slow into a stun. Riposte is also 24s at rank 1 — long enough to bait with a raw Q and then tether.
audit.corrected: Riposte only stuns if it blocked CC — bait it with a raw Q, then land the tether in its 24s downtime. Lunge, Bladework and Grand Challenge named; Lunge applies on-hit effects, so it is not an armour-only problem.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun, no source.
audit.why: Her healing is Vital procs (Duelist's Dance) and Grand Challenge's completion heal.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named against Vital healing and Grand Challenge.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: She has Lunge and Riposte by 2 — she dashes through your poke and blanks your tether.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Lunge applies on-hit effects and her Vital procs heal her, so your chip never sticks through a dash trade.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Riposte — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Her duel peak: Riposte (20s at rank 3) parries a cast and stuns you if it blocked your root, then she runs you down.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Mantra was up at 1, so 6 is flat; Grand Challenge reveals every Vital and heals her through the duel.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Her first duel item plus Vital healing out-trades your single AP item in any straight duel.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: You reclaim it through utility — RW root, RE ripple and roams while she is an island on the side lane.

edits.before: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Riposte parries all damage, and it only stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect — so never lead with the root.

edits.before: Track Fiora’s Riposte: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and only stuns if it blocked CC — bait it with a raw Q, then tether once it is spent.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1; it parries all damage and only stuns if it blocked CC, so bait it with a raw Q before the tether. - Budget E shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Malignance or Blackfire Torch into Sorcs; then Cosmic Drive / Zhonya's by threat. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Malignance or Blackfire Torch into Sorcs; then Cosmic Drive / Zhonya's by threat. Anti-heal blunts Vitals and her R heal.

edits.before: By 2-3 she has both her Q-dash and her W parry, gap-closing through your Q poke and blocking your W tether the moment you cast it.
edits.after: By 2-3 she has Lunge and Riposte, gap-closing through your Q poke and parrying Focused Resolve — which upgrades her stab into a stun.

edits.before: Parry (W) your W tether or RQ Soulflare to stun you, blank your key damage, then all-in
edits.after: Riposte your Focused Resolve — blocking the root is what turns her stab from a slow into a stun, then she all-ins

notes: UNVERIFIED, left alone deliberately: whys[2], early and wants.foe[1] describe Vital procs as 'percent-max-HP true damage'. Riot's kit text for Duelist's Dance only says hitting a Vital restores health and grants move speed, and the derived flags put trueDamage on Grand Challenge, not the passive. I could not confirm the damage type or scaling from the kits, so I did not touch those strings — flagging rather than guessing. The mirror's biggest fix (six fields calling Karma's root 'Mantra-Q' when it is Focused Resolve) does not recur on this page: Karma's side already says W tether throughout. Only 22 Emerald+ games at 50%, so no side was flipped on the sample — the chart follows the mirror.
